Name: The Trials of the Teleporting Totems
Author: zilchaz
Description:
The new way to learn the power of Warping Magic.

Playing with a new save is recommended for immersion purposes.

[font=Arial][color=#ea9999][size=5]Features[/size][/color][/font]
[font=Arial][size=4]Bundles[/size][/font]
Instead of learning Warp Totem recipes by reaching a skill level, the Wizard will introduce you to the lore of warping magic.

Totemic bundles only appear at their designated locations between 9 PM and 12 AM. You must complete a bundle to gain totemic knowledge. There are five bundles in total, unlocked in the following sequence:
[spoiler]
[list]
[*] Mountain
[*] Beach
[*] Desert
[*] Island
[*] ???
[/list]
[/spoiler]

[font=Arial][size=4]Unlock Return Scepter[/size][/font]
Instead of buying the Return Scepter from Krobus directly. You must meet conditions before Krobus will offer the Return Scepter in his shop.

[font=Arial][color=#ea9999][size=5]Events Condition[/size][/color][/font]
[spoiler]
[size=4][b]Totemic Bundle Intro[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] In Mountain
[*] Time: 9 PM - 12 PM
[*] Foraging skill level 6
[/list]

[size=4][b]Unlock Return Scepter[/b][/size]
[list]
[*] In Sewer
[*] Must have at least 6 hearts with [b]Krobus[/b]
[*] Completed 3 Totemic Warp Point bundles (Mountain, Beach, and Desert)
[/list]
[/spoiler]

[color=#ea9999][size=5]Configurable[/size][/color]
[list]
[*]Lock totem recipes behind bundles (default: true)
[*]Lock Obelisks behind bundles (default: false)
[/list]
[font=Arial][color=#ea9999][size=5]Compatible[/size][/color][/font]
[list]
[*][b]Not compatible[/b] with mods that change maps' warp point location.
[/list]


[font=Arial][color=#e06666][size=5]!! Known Issues !!
[/size][/color][/font]With the latest version (v.1.0.1), this bug should be fixed, but I'd leave these commands in case they aren't.:[font=Arial][color=#e06666][size=5]
[/size][/color][/font][spoiler]
[s]Currently, the bundle is applied during events, so it won’t trigger if the player skips them. This will be fixed in a future update, but it may take some time as I’m currently very busy in real life.[/s]

As a temporary fix, you can manually apply the bundle using debug commands directly into the SMAPI console.:
[code]ub Discover <Key>[/code]
Available keys:
[list]
[*]Mountain Bundle: [code]Zilch.MountainTotemicBundle[/code]
[*]Beach Bundle: [code]Zilch.BeachTotemicBundle[/code]
[*]Desert Bundle: [code]Zilch.DesertTotemicBundle[/code]
[*]Island Bundle: [code]Zilch.IslandTotemicBundle[/code]
[*]???? Bundle: [code]Zilch.UnidentifiedBundle[/code]
[/list]
[/spoiler]
